_comment: ANOVA-family robustness battery on revenue across regions: equal-variance F (TEST_ANOVA_F), Welch's F (TEST_ANOVA_WELCH), and Brown-Forsythe homogeneity (TEST_BROWN_FORSYTHE). Lets an analyst compare the headline F under the equal-variance assumption against the heteroscedasticity-robust Welch F, with the Brown-Forsythe gate making the assumption check explicit.
